items.markdown:
A [Golden Visa](https://www.henleyglobal.com/residence-investment/golden-visa) is `a residency-by-investment program that grants foreign nationals the right to live, work, and study in a country in exchange for a qualifying financial investment`.[[1]](https://www.henleyglobal.com/residence-investment/golden-visa)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Immigrant_investor_programs)[[3]](https://immigrantinvest.com/blog/golden-visa-for-us-citizens/)

### How It Works

- **Investment Required:** Applicants must buy real estate, fund local businesses, invest in government bonds, or make a cultural donation.
- **Residency vs. Citizenship:** A golden visa gives you legal residency, not an immediate passport. It can often lead to permanent residency or citizenship after meeting time and language requirements.
- **Family Inclusion:** Most programs let you include your spouse and dependent children on a single application.
- **Travel Freedom:** European golden visas typically grant visa-free travel across the [Schengen Area](https://etias.com/articles/guide-to-european-golden-visas).[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/23/realestate/golden-visa-panama-portugal-greece-costa-rica.html)[[2]](https://www.investopedia.com/golden-visa-countries-8356287)[[3]](https://www.henleyglobal.com/residence-investment/golden-visa)[[4]](https://www.myexpattaxes.com/expat-tax-tips/investing/top-5-golden-visas-in-europe-guide/)[[5]](https://immigrantinvest.com/blog/golden-visa-for-us-citizens/)

### Popular Destinations

- **Greece:** Requires investments starting at €250,000 for specific real estate or up to €800,000 in high-demand areas, plus fund or business options.
- **Portugal:** Focuses heavily on fund investments or cultural donations starting around €500,000, with minimal physical stay requirements.
- **Costa Rica:** Offers residency through a $150,000 investment in real estate or approved financial assets.
- **United States:** Operates the employment-based [EB-5 Program](https://www.investopedia.com/golden-visa-countries-8356287) requiring qualifying job-creating commercial investments.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/23/realestate/golden-visa-panama-portugal-greece-costa-rica.html)[[2]](https://www.goldenvisas.com/portugal)[[3]](https://www.investopedia.com/golden-visa-countries-8356287)

### Recent Changes and Risks

- **Program Closures:** Countries like the UK, Ireland, and Spain have tightened or ended their programs due to housing market pressures and security concerns.
- **Tax Status:** Holding a golden visa does not automatically make you a tax resident, but rules vary widely by country.[[1]](https://www.myexpattaxes.com/expat-tax-tips/investing/top-5-golden-visas-in-europe-guide/)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/BloombergTelevision/videos/whats-a-golden-visa-and-where-can-you-get-one/2023357131522777/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ys6e2d6-EPc)
